exposure: social support (perceived emotional and practical support)
outcome: breastfeeding in mothers following preterm birth
cohort: The study included 130 women (71 mothers of preterm infants and 59 mothers of full-term infants) in the early postpartum period.
finding: Social support, particularly perceived emotional and practical support, was significantly associated with successful early lactation, with women receiving adequate support more likely to initiate breastfeeding early and maintain lactation.
cross-section timing: early postpartum period (data collected between December 2022 and March 2023)
